limits: Profiling, unminified scripts and the console timing observer change cost and scheduling. These values do not measure normal-build speed.
Component spans include descendants and can overlap. Effect spans can overlap. Do not add different components or phases into CPU totals.
Scheduler Render, Commit and Remaining Effects are clipped wall-interval unions by label. Update Blocked and Waiting are latency spans, not active CPU work.
Root actualDuration is the value emitted by one App Profiler for each callback. It is separate from the inclusive component and scheduler measures.
Zero-duration and coarse timing spans remain recorded. No self-duration inference is made.
All 300 ordered updates are verified after the diagnostic window; this does not prove that every update rendered within the window.

build.reproducibility: The two rejected builds ran from repository roots. Matching the normal Vite command working directory restores exact CSS and asset bytes. Only hidden source maps are added.

limits: The normal production capture includes trace and CPU instrumentation. It is diagnostic and not a speed comparison.
Negative CPU profile deltas invalidate duration weighting. All results count recorded sample points; no CPU milliseconds or CPU percentage is inferred.
Inclusive stack counts overlap; do not sum them. The program pseudo-frame remains unattributed.
Raw CDP line numbers are zero-based and converted to one-based only for the source-map lookup. Columns use UTF-16 code units.

All 1253 normal assets match byte for byte. The private output adds only 604 hidden source maps. Each mapped JavaScript script is identical to the recorded production script. Original source contents are checked where they resolve inside the app source root.
A source-map location identifies recorded code position. It does not establish why a function ran or that its full enclosing subtree is avoidable.

rejectedBuilds.reason: Forty-two normal asset paths fail the strict byte identity guard. Source maps excluded from sample attribution. Normal assets untouched. Investigate before any map use.
Root working directory still produces extra CSS and changed asset references. No source maps used in speed testing. Next build uses the same apps/web working directory as pnpm build:vite.

preflightFailures.reason: New audit used null/newline separators and a global path sort. The established asset receipt uses literal backslash separators and per-directory locale sorting. Use that exact established algorithm; retain byte comparisons for every normal asset.

Second preflight used literal backslashes. Direct read-only calculation confirms the established 9e20 tree uses null/newline delimiters and per-directory ordering. Both preflight failures are preserved. No app source or assets changed.

normalProductionSourceMapping.preflightExplanationCorrection: An intermediate note incorrectly described literal backslash delimiters as canonical. Direct calculation and the final exact asset audit use null/newline delimiters and per-directory ordering. Both earlier failures remain preserved.

interpretation: Private React profiling records 892 root callbacks in a 10.106-second window. Root actualDuration totals 3672.1 ms. Scheduler label unions record 4432.2 ms Render, 293.7 ms Commit and 653.8 ms Remaining Effects. These different measures are not additive.
Component render and effect spans include descendants and overlap. They do not provide component self CPU time.
Browser metadata confirms ANGLE SwiftShader and software compositing in Linux Headless Chrome. This limits prediction of M2 Air behavior.

The normal CPU profile maps the generic panel scroll listener, selection checks, React context propagation and store subscription checks to their source. The program pseudo-frame remains unattributed.
Negative CPU deltas prevent duration weighting. The 96222 clipped sample points are counts, not CPU milliseconds or percentages.

The generic panel scroll listener is the lead for sharing the native handler offset while retaining generic hide/show restoration. Its CPU samples do not prove that removing a read removes the underlying layout cost.
nextAction: Confirm the complete shared-scroll candidate across six unchanged native-v2 pairs before retention. The 20% streaming task-time target and original-baseline final matrix remain open.
